LightningComponentBundle.description: Extracts text from images on-device using Chrome's Gemini Nano, a Transformers.js vision model, or a local Ollama server. Ported from the Ollama-OCR Python project.

property.label: Vision model
property.description: Hugging Face model id (ONNX vision-language model) used by the Transformers.js engine.

property.name: ollamaEndpoint
property.label: Ollama endpoint
property.description: Base URL of the user's local Ollama server.

property.name: ollamaModel
property.label: Ollama model
property.description: Vision model name pulled in the user's local Ollama.
